newsitem.title: TURKEY: TURK SHARES DIVE ON POLITICAL CONCERNS, OFF LOWS.
newsitem.headline: TURK SHARES DIVE ON POLITICAL CONCERNS, OFF LOWS.

text.p: Istanbul shares dived on Thursday amid worries over the fate of Turkey's Islamist-led coalition government following a 6-1/2 day holiday, but rebounded from lows on late reaction buys, brokers said.
The IMKB National-100 .XU100 closed at 1,457, down 75 points, or 4.9 percent from the April 17 midday close of 1,532. It brushed a low of 1,420 in the morning session.
